title: SE Methodologies & Architecture Learning Path
description: Build a strong foundation in software engineering methodologies. Start with UML system modeling, progress through clean code and testing practices, then apply design patterns and microservices architecture in real PHP projects.
descriptionId: Bangun fondasi yang kuat dalam metodologi rekayasa perangkat lunak. Mulai dengan pemodelan sistem UML, lanjutkan melalui praktik clean code dan pengujian, lalu terapkan design patterns dan arsitektur microservices dalam proyek PHP nyata.
prerequisites: Familiarity with basic programming concepts; PHP or similar OOP language recommended.
prerequisitesId: Terbiasa dengan konsep dasar pemrograman; PHP atau bahasa OOP serupa direkomendasikan.

steps.title: UML Mini Series — Introduction to UML & Use Case Diagram
steps.titleId: Seri Mini UML — Pengenalan UML & Use Case Diagram
steps.description: Learn the fundamentals of UML and how to create Use Case diagrams for software system modeling.
steps.descriptionId: Pelajari dasar-dasar UML dan cara membuat diagram Use Case untuk pemodelan sistem perangkat lunak.

steps.title: UML Mini Series — Use Case Scenario
steps.titleId: Seri Mini UML — Use Case Scenario
steps.description: Understand how to write detailed use case scenarios that describe system interactions step by step.
steps.descriptionId: Pahami cara menulis skenario use case yang rinci untuk menggambarkan interaksi sistem langkah demi langkah.

steps.title: UML Mini Series — Activity Diagram
steps.description: Model workflows and business processes with UML Activity Diagrams for clearer system logic.
steps.descriptionId: Modelkan alur kerja dan proses bisnis dengan Activity Diagram UML untuk logika sistem yang lebih jelas.

steps.title: PlantUML — Text-Based UML Diagramming
steps.titleId: PlantUML — Pembuatan Diagram UML Berbasis Teks
steps.description: Generate UML diagrams from plain text descriptions. Used throughout SE Lab tutorials for clear, versionable diagrams.
steps.descriptionId: Hasilkan diagram UML dari deskripsi teks biasa. Digunakan di seluruh tutorial SE Lab untuk diagram yang jelas dan dapat diversikan.

steps.title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education — MIT
steps.description: Master the command line, version control (Git), debugging, and other tools that CS programs often skip.
steps.descriptionId: Kuasai command line, version control (Git), debugging, dan alat lain yang sering dilewatkan oleh program CS.

steps.title: UML Mini Series — Sequence Diagram
steps.description: Visualize object interactions and message flows over time using UML Sequence Diagrams.
steps.descriptionId: Visualisasikan interaksi objek dan aliran pesan dari waktu ke waktu menggunakan Sequence Diagram UML.

steps.title: UML Mini Series — Class Diagram & Laravel Realization
steps.titleId: Seri Mini UML — Class Diagram & Realisasi Laravel
steps.description: Design class diagrams and see how they translate into a real Laravel PHP application.
steps.descriptionId: Rancang class diagram dan lihat bagaimana diagram tersebut diterjemahkan ke dalam aplikasi Laravel PHP nyata.

steps.title: Clean Code Principles with PHP
steps.description: Master clean code practices — meaningful names, small functions, SOLID principles — applied in PHP.
steps.descriptionId: Kuasai praktik clean code — penamaan bermakna, fungsi kecil, prinsip SOLID — diterapkan dalam PHP.

steps.title: Test-Driven Development (TDD) with PHP
steps.description: Learn the red-green-refactor cycle and how to write test-first code using PHPUnit.
steps.descriptionId: Pelajari siklus red-green-refactor dan cara menulis kode test-first menggunakan PHPUnit.

steps.title: PHPUnit — The PHP Testing Framework
steps.description: The standard testing framework for PHP, essential for TDD and automated testing workflows.
steps.descriptionId: Framework pengujian standar untuk PHP, esensial untuk TDD dan alur kerja pengujian otomatis.

steps.title: Blackbox and Whitebox Testing in Simple Way
steps.titleId: Cara Sederhana Melakukan Pengujian Blackbox dan Whitebox
steps.description: Practical guide to blackbox and whitebox testing techniques with step-by-step examples.
steps.descriptionId: Panduan praktis teknik pengujian blackbox dan whitebox dengan contoh langkah demi langkah.

steps.title: Design Patterns with PHP
steps.description: Explore creational, structural, and behavioral design patterns with practical PHP examples.
steps.descriptionId: Jelajahi pola desain creational, structural, dan behavioral dengan contoh praktis PHP.

steps.title: Laravel — The PHP Framework for Web Artisans
steps.titleId: Laravel — Framework PHP untuk Web Artisans
steps.description: Elegant PHP web framework with expressive syntax, used extensively in SE Lab projects and tutorials.
steps.descriptionId: Framework web PHP yang elegan dengan sintaks ekspresif, digunakan secara luas di proyek dan tutorial SE Lab.

steps.title: Postman — API Development Platform
steps.description: Collaborative platform for designing, testing, and documenting REST and GraphQL APIs.
steps.descriptionId: Platform kolaboratif untuk merancang, menguji, dan mendokumentasikan REST dan GraphQL API.

steps.title: GitHub Actions — CI/CD & Automation
steps.description: Automate software workflows including CI/CD, testing, and deployment directly from GitHub repositories.
steps.descriptionId: Otomatiskan alur kerja perangkat lunak termasuk CI/CD, pengujian, dan deployment langsung dari repositori GitHub.

steps.title: Microservices Architecture Fundamentals with PHP
steps.description: Understand microservices concepts — service decomposition, API gateways, inter-service communication — in PHP.
steps.descriptionId: Pahami konsep microservices — dekomposisi layanan, API gateway, komunikasi antar layanan — dalam PHP.

steps.title: Docker — Container Platform
steps.description: Package applications into containers for consistent development, testing, and deployment across environments.
steps.descriptionId: Kemas aplikasi ke dalam kontainer untuk pengembangan, pengujian, dan deployment yang konsisten di berbagai lingkungan.

steps.title: Software Engineering Body of Knowledge (SWEBOK v4)
steps.titleId: Software Engineering Body of Knowledge (SWEBOK v4)
steps.description: IEEE Computer Society's comprehensive guide to the body of knowledge in software engineering.
steps.descriptionId: Panduan komprehensif IEEE Computer Society tentang body of knowledge dalam rekayasa perangkat lunak.

steps.title: The SE Lab Book Collection
steps.description: Browse books authored and co-authored by SE Lab researchers covering software engineering, programming, and academic topics.
steps.descriptionId: Jelajahi buku yang ditulis dan ditulis bersama oleh peneliti SE Lab yang mencakup rekayasa perangkat lunak, pemrograman, dan topik akademik.

steps.title: Presentation Decks Archive
steps.description: Access slide decks and presentation materials created by SE Lab researchers for seminars, workshops, and teaching.
steps.descriptionId: Akses slide dan materi presentasi yang dibuat oleh peneliti SE Lab untuk seminar, lokakarya, dan pengajaran.

title: Domain-Specific SE Applications Learning Path
titleId: Jalur Pembelajaran Aplikasi SE Berbasis Domain
description: Explore how software engineering principles are applied in specific domains like education, fintech, and healthcare. Start with foundational full-stack skills, then dive into domain-specific projects and tools used in real-world applications.
descriptionId: Jelajahi bagaimana prinsip rekayasa perangkat lunak diterapkan di domain spesifik seperti pendidikan, fintech, dan kesehatan. Mulai dengan keterampilan full-stack dasar, lalu selami proyek berbasis domain dan alat yang digunakan dalam aplikasi dunia nyata.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of programming fundamentals; HTML/CSS knowledge helpful.
prerequisitesId: Pemahaman dasar tentang fundamental pemrograman; pengetahuan HTML/CSS membantu.

steps.title: CS50 — Harvard's Introduction to Computer Science
steps.description: Renowned introductory computer science course covering algorithms, data structures, software engineering, and web development.
steps.descriptionId: Kursus pengantar ilmu komputer terkenal yang mencakup algoritma, struktur data, rekayasa perangkat lunak, dan pengembangan web.

steps.title: FreeCodeCamp — Full Stack Development Curriculum
steps.description: Free, self-paced curriculum covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, databases, and more with hands-on projects.
steps.descriptionId: Kurikulum gratis dan mandiri yang mencakup HTML, CSS, JavaScript, basis data, dan lainnya dengan proyek langsung.

steps.title: Kaggle Datasets — Public Data for Research
steps.titleId: Kaggle Datasets — Data Publik untuk Riset
steps.description: Platform for finding and sharing datasets for machine learning, data analysis, and software engineering research.
steps.descriptionId: Platform untuk menemukan dan berbagi dataset untuk machine learning, analisis data, dan riset rekayasa perangkat lunak.

steps.title: Google Scholar — Academic Literature Search
steps.description: Search across scholarly literature including articles, theses, books, and conference papers from academic publishers.
steps.descriptionId: Cari literatur ilmiah termasuk artikel, tesis, buku, dan makalah konferensi dari penerbit akademik.

steps.title: SE Lab Projects Repository
steps.description: Explore open-source and applied software projects developed by SE Lab researchers across all research streams. Study real EdTech, fintech, and healthcare projects.
steps.descriptionId: Jelajahi proyek perangkat lunak open-source dan terapan yang dikembangkan oleh peneliti SE Lab di semua stream riset. Pelajari proyek nyata EdTech, fintech, dan kesehatan.

steps.title: UML Mini Series — Class Diagram & Laravel Realization
steps.titleId: Seri Mini UML — Class Diagram & Realisasi Laravel
steps.description: Apply UML class diagram principles to structure domain models and translate them into real PHP/Laravel applications.
steps.descriptionId: Terapkan prinsip class diagram UML untuk menyusun model domain dan menerjemahkannya ke aplikasi PHP/Laravel nyata.

steps.title: Design Patterns with PHP
steps.description: Apply creational, structural, and behavioral patterns to build clean domain-driven applications.
steps.descriptionId: Terapkan pola creational, structural, dan behavioral untuk membangun aplikasi berbasis domain yang bersih.

steps.title: Laravel — The PHP Framework for Web Artisans
steps.titleId: Laravel — Framework PHP untuk Web Artisans
steps.description: Build domain-specific web apps with Laravel's elegant syntax and ecosystem of tools.
steps.descriptionId: Bangun aplikasi web berbasis domain dengan sintaks elegan dan ekosistem alat Laravel.

steps.title: Microservices Architecture Fundamentals with PHP
steps.description: Design domain-specific microservices for fintech, edtech, and healthcare use cases with proper service boundaries.
steps.descriptionId: Rancang microservices berbasis domain untuk kasus fintech, edtech, dan kesehatan dengan batasan layanan yang tepat.

steps.title: Web-Based Thesis Management Platform
steps.titleId: Platform Manajemen Tugas Akhir Berbasis Web
steps.description: Study a real open-source platform that streamlines thesis proposal submission, supervisor assignment, and progress tracking for academic departments.
steps.descriptionId: Pelajari platform open-source nyata yang menyederhanakan pengajuan proposal TA, penugasan pembimbing, dan pelacakan kemajuan untuk jurusan akademik.

steps.title: Publication Archive
steps.description: Browse scholarly outputs across domain-specific software engineering, including EdTech and applied systems research.
steps.descriptionId: Jelajahi keluaran ilmiah di bidang rekayasa perangkat lunak berbasis domain, termasuk EdTech dan riset sistem terapan.

title: Emerging Technologies in SE Learning Path
titleId: Jalur Pembelajaran Teknologi Berkembang dalam SE
description: Stay ahead with AI-assisted tools and automation in software engineering. Learn static analysis, automated testing, and how large language models can accelerate development workflows and improve code quality.
descriptionId: Tetap terdepan dengan alat berbasis AI dan otomatisasi dalam rekayasa perangkat lunak. Pelajari static analysis, pengujian otomatis, dan bagaimana model bahasa besar dapat mempercepat alur kerja pengembangan dan meningkatkan kualitas kode.
prerequisites: Intermediate programming skills; familiarity with unit testing concepts recommended.
prerequisitesId: Keterampilan pemrograman tingkat menengah; keakraban dengan konsep unit testing direkomendasikan.

steps.title: ESLint — Pluggable JavaScript Linter
steps.titleId: ESLint — Linter JavaScript yang Dapat Diperluas
steps.description: Start with static analysis basics by configuring ESLint to identify problematic patterns in JavaScript and TypeScript code.
steps.descriptionId: Mulai dengan dasar static analysis dengan mengonfigurasi ESLint untuk mengidentifikasi pola bermasalah dalam kode JavaScript dan TypeScript.

steps.title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education — MIT
steps.description: Master the command line, version control (Git), debugging, and other tools that CS programs often skip.
steps.descriptionId: Kuasai command line, version control (Git), debugging, dan alat lain yang sering dilewatkan oleh program CS.

steps.title: Google IT Automation with Python — Coursera
steps.titleId: Google IT Automation dengan Python — Coursera
steps.description: Professional certificate covering Python, Git, troubleshooting, and automation techniques for IT and development.
steps.descriptionId: Sertifikat profesional yang mencakup Python, Git, troubleshooting, dan teknik otomatisasi untuk IT dan pengembangan.

steps.title: SonarQube — Continuous Code Quality Inspection
steps.description: Set up industry-standard static analysis for detecting bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells. Integrate with CI/CD pipelines.
steps.descriptionId: Siapkan static analysis standar industri untuk mendeteksi bug, kerentanan, dan code smell. Integrasikan dengan pipeline CI/CD.

steps.title: GitHub Actions — CI/CD & Automation
steps.description: Automate linting, testing, and quality gates in your CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions workflows.
steps.descriptionId: Otomatiskan linting, pengujian, dan quality gate di pipeline CI/CD Anda menggunakan alur kerja GitHub Actions.

steps.title: Clean Code Principles with PHP
steps.description: Apply clean code practices — meaningful names, small functions, SOLID principles — that static analysis tools help enforce.
steps.descriptionId: Terapkan praktik clean code — penamaan bermakna, fungsi kecil, prinsip SOLID — yang dibantu penegakannya oleh alat static analysis.

steps.title: Test-Driven Development (TDD) with PHP
steps.description: Master the red-green-refactor cycle with PHPUnit. Foundation for understanding AI-assisted test generation.
steps.descriptionId: Kuasai siklus red-green-refactor dengan PHPUnit. Dasar untuk memahami pembuatan test berbantuan AI.

steps.title: AI-Assisted Unit Test Generation with PHP
steps.titleId: Pembuatan Unit Test Berbantuan AI dengan PHP
steps.description: Learn how AI tools can accelerate unit test creation and improve test coverage in PHP projects using large language models.
steps.descriptionId: Pelajari bagaimana alat AI dapat mempercepat pembuatan unit test dan meningkatkan cakupan pengujian di proyek PHP menggunakan model bahasa besar.

steps.title: AI-Assisted Software Testing: From Research to Practice
steps.titleId: Pengujian Perangkat Lunak Berbantuan AI: Dari Riset ke Praktik
steps.description: Seminar exploring the current state of AI-assisted software testing research and practical applications across the development lifecycle.
steps.descriptionId: Seminar yang mengeksplorasi kondisi terkini riset pengujian perangkat lunak berbantuan AI dan aplikasi praktisnya di seluruh siklus pengembangan.

steps.title: OpenAI API — AI-Powered Development
steps.description: Integrate large language models into software applications for code generation, analysis, and automation.
steps.descriptionId: Integrasikan model bahasa besar ke dalam aplikasi perangkat lunak untuk pembuatan kode, analisis, dan otomatisasi.

steps.title: Blackbox and Whitebox Testing in Simple Way
steps.titleId: Cara Sederhana Melakukan Pengujian Blackbox dan Whitebox
steps.description: Understand testing fundamentals that ground AI-assisted approaches. Practical blackbox and whitebox techniques with step-by-step examples.
steps.descriptionId: Pahami fundamental pengujian yang mendasari pendekatan berbantuan AI. Teknik blackbox dan whitebox praktis dengan contoh langkah demi langkah.

steps.title: Publication Archive
steps.description: Browse scholarly publications on code quality analysis, bug prediction, and AI test generation from SE Lab researchers.
steps.descriptionId: Jelajahi publikasi ilmiah tentang analisis kualitas kode, prediksi bug, dan pembuatan test berbasis AI dari peneliti SE Lab.
